title: Physics For Integrated Science
modules: Wave Nature Of Light, Velocity Of Light
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the distance travelled in unit time."
Speed is the distance travelled in unit time.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the effect produced when two waves of the same frequency, amplitude and wavelength travelling in the same direction in a medium are superposed - as they simultaneously pass through a given point."

Interference is the effect produced when two waves of the same frequency, amplitude and wavelength travelling in the same direction in a medium are superposed - as they simultaneously pass through a given point.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the materials that conduct heat well."
Thermal Conductors are the materials that conduct heat well.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the change in the speed and direction of the wave as they cross the boundary between two media of different densities."
Refraction is the change in the speed and direction of the wave as they cross the boundary between two media of different densities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the materials that conduct heat poorly."
Thermal Insulators are the materials that conduct heat poorly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a device used to convert thermal energy (i.e heat) into mechanical work and then exhausts the heat which cannot be used to do work."
A heat engine is a device used to convert thermal energy (i.e heat) into mechanical work and then exhausts the heat which cannot be used to do work.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phenomenon whereby a wave whose vibrations are only in one plane is produced."
Polarization is a phenomenon whereby a wave whose vibrations are only in one plane is produced.
fib: ______ can be defined as the ability of waves to bend around obstacles in their path.
Diffraction
Diffraction can be defined as the ability of waves to bend around obstacles in their path.
______ is a disturbance which travels through a medium and transfer energy from one point to another, without causing any permanent displacement of the medium itself.
wave
A wave is a disturbance which travels through a medium and transfer energy from one point to another, without causing any permanent displacement of the medium itself.
______ is the process of heat transfer whereby heat is transferred directly through a material without any bulk movement of the material.
Conduction
Conduction is the process of heat transfer whereby heat is transferred directly through a material without any bulk movement of the material.
______ is the change of velocity in unit time.
Acceleration
Acceleration is the change of velocity in unit time.
______ are derived of two or all three combinations of the fundamental physical quantities, ditto the units.
Derived quantities
Derived quantities are derived of two or all three combinations of the fundamental physical quantities, ditto the units.
______ is a change in position of a body with time, which involves how things move and what makes them to move.
Motion
Motion is a change in position of a body with time, which involves how things move and what makes them to move.
______ are the quantities that have only magnitude but no direction.
Scalar quantities
Scalar quantities are the quantities that have only magnitude but no direction.
